live_matches.description: UFC Fight Night headlines with a high-stakes featherweight clash between Arnold Allen and Melquizael Costa. Arnold Allen looks to defend his top spot and bounce back after losses to elite competition, relying on experience and technical skill. Melquizael Costa enters on a 6-fight win streak, bringing momentum, aggression, and finishing ability. Tune in to catch all the action from UFC Fight Night, LIVE on Sony LIV.
